'''Weeteef Cyu-Bee''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Talpini]] who served as one of the most destructive members of [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]] on [[Jedha]]. The diminutive Talpini could hide easily among the taller beings that congregated in the [[Jedha City|Holy city]]. A [[sniper]], Cyu-Bee specialized in explosives, and built the sticky bombs used against the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] patrols of [[All Terrain Scout Transport|AT-ST]] [[walker]]s and [[TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank|TX-225 assault tanks]].

==Biography==
[[File:Weeteef_Cyu-Bee_battle.png|thumb|left|223x223px|Weeteef during the Battle of Jedha]]
A [[Gender|male]] member of the diminutive [[Talpini]] [[species]]<ref name="Databank" /> from [[Tal Pi]],<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" /> Weeteef Cyu-Bee joined [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]] on the [[moon]] of [[Jedha]] prior to the [[Galactic Civil War]]. He became a valuable member of the group,<ref name="Databank" /> as well as being, pound for pound, one of the Partisans' most destructive fighters. His diminutive size allowed him to hide easily among the taller beings that crowded the streets of [[Jedha City]],<ref name="UVG" /> and for this reason his small stature earned him infiltration missions into the [[city]]. A sharpshooter known for carrying a [[blaster pistol]],<ref name="Databank" /> Weeteef also utilized a [[tibanna]]-jacked [[DH-17 blaster pistol|DH-17]]/[[E-11 medium blaster rifle|E-11]] [[DH-17/E-11 hybrid custom|hybrid custom]] [[blaster rifle]], and was an explosives specialist. He custom-built [[sticky bomb]]s used by the Partisans against [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] patrol vehicles in the Holy City,<ref name="UVG" /> where the clever bomb-builder used his creations to bring down [[All Terrain Scout Transport]]s and [[TX-225 GAVw "Occupier" combat assault tank]]s.<ref name="Databank" />

In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="ROdate">{{FilmDate|RO}}</ref> Weeteef participated in a [[Battle on Jedha|skirmish]] against an Imperial patrol in [[Tythoni Square]]. Weeteef's fellow insurrectionists attacked a TX-225 and its [[stormtrooper]] escorts in an attempt to steal the [[kyber crystal container]]s under transportation.<ref name="UVG" /> Weeteef hid behind a low wall, communicating with his compatriots via [[comlink]], and opened fire after explosives were launched at the patrol. Following the battle, Weeteef returned to the Partisans' base in the [[Catacombs of Cadera]], handing over his [[blaster]] while the [[human]] [[Jyn Erso]], who had claimed to know Gerrera, was led through the chambers to meet with Gerrera.<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Weeteef Cyu-Bee was created for the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|film]] ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', and is portrayed by [[Warwick Davis]] under an animatronic headpiece. His look was inspired by a piranha, and his name is a slang derivation of his tiny, sharp [[Tooth|incisors]] ("wee teeth").<ref name="EW" /> His production name was "Tiny Teef" due to his small teeth. When it was decided that his real name would be Cyu-Bee, [[Pablo Hidalgo]] insisted that Cyu-Bee only be part of his name and that his full name started with Weeteef.<ref name="Much to Learn">{{SW|url=news/much-to-learn-you-still-have-talking-rogue-one-aliens-with-pablo-hidalgo|text=Much to Learn You Still Have: Talking ''Rogue One'' Aliens with Pablo Hidalgo}}</ref>
